Name: Jeiel, of the Sons of Elizaphan
Summary: Jeiel, of the sons of Elizaphan, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Shimri, of the Sons of Elizaphan; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Two men of one clan stood together for a clean temple.
